data.name: Husaim
data.gender_notes: Husaim is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Husaim is the name of a prophet in Islamic history. His story is found in various Hadiths and is known for his unwavering loyalty and bravery. He was a companion of Imam Hussein and played a pivotal role in the Battle of Karbala, which is a significant event in Shia Islam. The name Husaim carries the meaning “Prophet of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Husaim usually hope their child will grow to embody prophet of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of unwavering loyalty and bravery in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Husaim belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Prophet of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Husaim total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: حسيم
in_arabic.meaning: معنى اسم حسيم: الشخص الممتاز والذى يتمتع بشخصية رائعة
in_arabic.long_meaning: حسيم: اللفظ مشتق من الحسيم، وهو اسم علم عربي يرمز إلى الشخص الممتاز والذى يتمتع بشخصية رائعة. في القرآن الكريم، يُذكَر الحسيم في سورة القصص، حيث كان من بين الملوك الذين اتبعوا دين الله. والاسم حَسيم يُشير إلى الشخص الذى يمتلك صفات مثل الشجاعة والصراحة والخلود. ويُستخدم اسم حسيم في الثقافة العربية لتسمية الأطفال الذكور، ويُعتبر من أسماء الله الحسنى في الإسلام. يُعتقد أن الشخص الذى يسمى حسيم سوف يكون متميزًا ومحبوبًا من الناس، ويُعتبر من أفضل الأسماء في الإسلام

in_urdu.name: حسیم
in_urdu.meaning: اسم حسیم کا مطلب: ایک ممتاز شخص جو اپنے کلام سے لوگوں کے دل پر حاوی رہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: حسیم: اس نام کا حصول اس سے ہوا ہے کہ اس کا مطلب ہے ایک ممتاز شخص جو اپنے کلام سے لوگوں کے دل پر حاوی رہے، جیسا کہ کربلاء میں نوجوان حسیم کے نام سے جانا جاتا ہے، جو شہداء کے ساتھ شہادت کی راہوں پر چلے گئے، انہوں نے اپنے خون سے ہر ایک کی سانسوں سے اڑ گئے۔ یہ نام ہمارے ان لوگوں کی شان ہے جو اپنے آپ کو لاعلمی سے نہیں چھپاتے، بلکہ اپنی جان کا قیمتی ساتھ دینے کی کوشش کرتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: हुसैम
in_hindi.meaning: हुसैम नाम का अर्थ: किसी भी स्थिति में अद्वितीय व्यक्ति जिसे सभी पसंद करते हैं
in_hindi.long_meaning: हुसैम: यह नाम अरबी भाषा से आया है और इसका अर्थ है किसी भी स्थिति में अद्वितीय व्यक्ति जिसे सभी पसंद करते हैं। हुसैम का नाम कुरआन में वर्णित है, जहां उन्होंने अपना सबकुछ अपने लोगों के लिए दिया। इस नाम का उपयोग भारतीय मुसलमानों द्वारा अपने बच्चों के नामकरण में किया जाता है, क्योंकि वे मानते हैं कि यह नाम उन्हें अपने लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त करने के लिए प्रेरित करेगा।

in_pashto.name: حسیم
in_pashto.meaning: حسیم نومېږي معنى: د ښه شخص چې ډیرو کسانو لپاره ښه دی

data.cultural_impact: The name Husaim holds a deep cultural significance within the Islamic community, particularly among Shia Muslims. It is a memorial to the valor and steadfastness shown by the Prophet Husaim during the Battle of Karbala. This event is commemorated annually during the religious observance of Ashura, and Husaim's name serves as a reminder of the importance of unwavering commitment and sacrifice in the face of adversity.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Husaim symbolizes loyalty and devotion to faith and to one's leader. It is a reminder of the importance of remaining steadfast in belief, especially during times of hardship and suffering. The Prophet Husaim's unwavering commitment to Imam Hussein despite the odds instills a sense of courage and determination within those who bear his name. Additionally, the Battle of Karbala and the sacrifices made during this event hold spiritual significance as they are a reminder of the importance of self-sacrifice and martyrdom in the pursuit of justice and righteousness.

historical_references.reference: Ali ibn Husain Zainabid, also known as Imam Husain ibn Ali, was the third Imam of Shia Islam and is considered a martyr for his role in the Battle of Karbala in 680 AD. He led a small group of his family and supporters against the much larger army of the Umayyad Caliph Yazid I.

Husain ibn Ali was also the grandson of Prophet Muhammad and the father of the famous caliph Al-Hassan and Al-Husayn. He was born in 626 AD in Mecca and was the youngest son of Imam Ali and Fatimah bint Muhammad.
